offline_design: 2x2 hook framing by opening format; creative screening only

hooks.question: Up fifty percent. Down forty percent. Why lose money?
hooks.result: Up fifty percent. Down forty percent. Still down ten.

body: Start with one dollar. A win adds fifty cents. Then a forty percent loss takes sixty cents. You have ninety cents left. A fair coin makes the average return positive, but compounding changes your path. Follow for clear thinking about risk.

hypotheses.contrast: result versus question, with opening format held constant
hypotheses.prediction: Giving the numerical consequence immediately improves early retention.
hypotheses.mechanism: Specific payoff reduces time to understanding.

hypotheses.contrast: presenter versus graphics, with hook held constant
hypotheses.prediction: A brief full-motion fictional presenter improves attention without reducing trust or follow conversion.
hypotheses.mechanism: Human presence may draw attention; synthetic appearance may instead harm trust.

controls: Same Kokoro Heart voice, speed and loudness target
Same source, claim ledger, body waveform, CTA, runtime and editor after the hook
Hook audio slot matched before assets are frozen; any padding recorded
Only opening format changes within each hook pair
Same synthetic-person disclosure on all arms
No music, paid boost, collab or personal-account traffic during a live comparison

live_plan.design: Directional matched-post pilot; NOT a randomized viewer-level A/B test
live_plan.primary_contrast: presenter versus graphics with result framing fixed, subject to human creative review before preregistration is frozen
live_plan.unit_of_analysis: post, blocked by article; viewers and views are not independent randomized replicates
live_plan.order_method: Prespecified counterbalanced order; platform exposure is not randomized
live_plan.primary_metric: 1000 * post_attributed_follows / accounts_reached, only when both fields are available
live_plan.downstream: Tagged site sessions and confirmed signups reported separately; never attribute a stable bio-link session to an individual post without evidence
live_plan.missing_values: null/blank, never zero; missing primary metrics prevents a conversion winner
live_plan.practical_effect: At least +2 follows per 1000 reached, with same-direction differences in at least 2 of 3 article blocks
guardrails: No clear deterioration greater than 20% in available watch-time ratio or share rate
Do not let one high-reach post alone establish a repeatable winner
live_plan.decision_time: After all six prespecified posts have complete seven-day observations; 48-hour results are diagnostic, not winner selection

decision_rules.insufficient: Any minimum-information or measurement gate fails: report inconclusive; do not call a winner or scale.
decision_rules.iterate: Reach/retention improves without follow conversion, or results conflict across blocks: revise one factor and register v2.
decision_rules.replicate: Practical effect and guardrails pass: treat as a candidate, then replicate in a separate approved wave of distinct content before scaling.
decision_rules.scale: Only after independent replication and human review; expand one small batch at a time without changing schedules or automating publication implicitly.
decision_rules.stop: Quality, rights or recommendation-eligibility failure: stop immediately and diagnose regardless of performance.

live_plan.threshold_note: Operator planning thresholds, NOT universal Instagram benchmarks, statistical significance, a power calculation or a promise of virality. Estimate post-level variance from the pilot before planning a confirmatory sample.
